name: work
description: The next-item command and the skills around it: what to work on next, claiming it, opening the pull request with a fresh review and landing it; pr-batch, which lands several of your own pull requests as one; coordinator, which assigns the work to other agents; long-loops and add-knowledge; hooks that let an agent run a plain gh pr merge in auto mode, warn at a merge with no fresh review, and offer to share what Claude saves to memory, and park work stopped by a usage limit on its pull request
